1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
2: //! Key encoding functions for Fjall keyspaces.
3: //!
4: //! Each key variant uses a specific binary format with a type prefix
5: //! followed by the payload fields in big-endian byte order.
6: 
7: use arrayvec::ArrayVec;
8: use std::ops::Range;
9: use vb_core::{ActionId, RunId, WorkflowId};
10: 
11: use crate::{
12:     JournalError,
13:     constants::{
14:         DIGEST_KEY_BYTES, INDEX_ACTION_KEY_BYTES, INDEX_STATUS_KEY_BYTES, INDEX_WORKFLOW_KEY_BYTES,
15:         JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES, PREFIX_BLOB, PREFIX_COMPILED_IR, PREFIX_INDEX_ACTION,
16:         PREFIX_INDEX_STATUS, PREFIX_INDEX_WORKFLOW, PREFIX_RUN_EVENT, PREFIX_RUN_HEADER,
17:         PREFIX_RUN_SNAPSHOT, PREFIX_WORKFLOW_SOURCE, RUN_ONLY_KEY_BYTES,
18:     },
19:     error::KeyDecodeError,
20:     types::{EventSeq, IndexStatusState, StorageKey},
21: };
22: 
23: /// Policy that decides how a keyspace iteration handles rows whose key
24: /// cannot be parsed back into a typed `StorageKey` (truncated bytes,
25: /// unknown prefix, or shape mismatch).
26: ///
27: /// Picking a single policy per call site is the unifying rule for CC-002:
28: /// production paths default to [`Self::FailClosed`]; diagnostic/doctor
29: /// callers that must keep scanning across partial corruption opt in to
30: /// [`Self::SkipMalformed`]. Never use `SkipMalformed` on a production
31: /// read path that is supposed to surface evidence of corruption.
32: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
33: pub enum KeyspaceScanPolicy {
34:     /// Surface the first malformed row as a typed
35:     /// [`crate::JournalError::MalformedKeyspaceRow`] error and abort the
36:     /// scan. This is the default for production paths.
37:     #[default]
38:     FailClosed,
39:     /// Skip malformed rows silently and continue scanning. Reserved for
40:     /// doctor/diagnostic tooling that must produce a partial view of a
41:     /// partially-corrupt keyspace. The caller is responsible for
42:     /// reporting the skipped count to the operator; the policy itself
43:     /// does not log.
44:     SkipMalformed,
45: }
46: 
47: impl KeyspaceScanPolicy {
48:     /// Returns the policy used by production scan APIs by default.
49:     pub const fn default_production() -> Self {
50:         Self::FailClosed
51:     }
52: 
53:     /// Returns the policy used by doctor/diagnostic scan APIs by
54:     /// default. Doctor paths must tolerate partial corruption so the
55:     /// operator can see whatever is still well-formed.
56:     pub const fn default_doctor() -> Self {
57:         Self::SkipMalformed
58:     }
59: }
60: 
61: /// Encodes `[0x01][workflow_digest_32]`.
62: pub fn workflow_source_key(
63:     digest: [u8; crate::constants::DIGEST_BYTES],
64: ) -> Result<[u8; DIGEST_KEY_BYTES], JournalError> {
65:     digest_key(PREFIX_WORKFLOW_SOURCE, digest)
66: }
67: 
68: /// Encodes `[0x02][compiled_digest_32]`.
69: pub fn compiled_ir_key(
70:     digest: [u8; crate::constants::DIGEST_BYTES],
71: ) -> Result<[u8; DIGEST_KEY_BYTES], JournalError> {
72:     digest_key(PREFIX_COMPILED_IR, digest)
73: }
74: 
75: /// Encodes `[0x10][run_id_u64_be]`.
76: pub fn run_header_key(run: RunId) -> Result<[u8; RUN_ONLY_KEY_BYTES], JournalError> {
77:     run_only_key(PREFIX_RUN_HEADER, run)
78: }
79: 
80: /// Encodes `[0x11][run_id_u64_be][seq_u64_be]`.
81: pub fn run_event_key(run: RunId, seq: EventSeq) -> Result<[u8; JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES], JournalError> {
82:     journal_key(run, seq)
83: }
84: 
85: /// Encodes `[0x12][run_id_u64_be][seq_u64_be]`.
86: pub fn run_snapshot_key(
87:     run: RunId,
88:     seq: EventSeq,
89: ) -> Result<[u8; JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES], JournalError> {
90:     sequenced_run_key(PREFIX_RUN_SNAPSHOT, run, seq)
91: }
92: 
93: /// Encodes `[0x20][blob_digest_32]`.
94: pub fn blob_key(
95:     digest: [u8; crate::constants::DIGEST_BYTES],
96: ) -> Result<[u8; DIGEST_KEY_BYTES], JournalError> {
97:     digest_key(PREFIX_BLOB, digest)
98: }
99: 
100: /// Encodes `[0x30][state_u8][timestamp_u64_be][run_id_u64_be]`.
